descriptors.concept_name: Investments In Subsidiaries, Associates And Joint Ventures
descriptors.definition: When an investor accounts for an investment in a subsidiary, associate, or joint venture using the cost or equity method, cash flow reporting is restricted to flows between the investor and the investee, such as dividends and advances. For equity-method interests, the investor includes cash flows concerning the investment itself along with any distributions or payments exchanged with the investee.
inclusion: Dividends paid or received between investor and investee
Advances between investor and investee
Cash flows regarding investments in equity-method associates or joint ventures
exclusion: Underlying operational cash flows generated independently within the investee entity
Full consolidation cash flows when equity or cost method applies
nearby_distinctions: Differs from full consolidation reporting which incorporates all individual asset and liability cash flows of the subsidiary rather than restricting items to direct dividends and advances.

descriptors.concept_name: Changes In Ownership Interests In Subsidiaries And Other Businesses
descriptors.definition: Aggregate cash flows resulting from obtaining or losing control of subsidiaries or other businesses must be presented separately under investing activities. Furthermore, cash flows arising from ownership changes in a subsidiary that do not result in a loss of control are classified as financing activities unless the subsidiary is held by an investment entity measured at fair value through profit or loss.
inclusion: Aggregate cash flows from gaining or losing control of subsidiaries
Cash flows from ownership changes not resulting in loss of control
exclusion: Transactions where an investment entity subsidiary is measured at fair value through profit or loss
Normal operating revenue and expense receipts
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between complete control alterations classified as investing activities versus partial ownership adjustments without loss of control classified as financing activities.

descriptors.concept_name: Classification of Cash Flows as Investing Activity
descriptors.definition: Aggregate cash flows arising from acquiring or relinquishing control of subsidiaries or other businesses are classified strictly as investing activities and presented separately. The net cash consideration paid or received is reported net of cash and cash equivalents acquired or disposed of in the transaction.
inclusion: Total consideration paid or received for control changes
Cash and cash equivalents acquired or disposed of in business changes
exclusion: Financing transactions involving partial equity changes without loss of control
nearby_distinctions: Separates major structural entity acquisition or disposal cash flows from routine operational or financing cash movements.

descriptors.concept_name: Classification of Cash Flows as Financing Activity
descriptors.definition: Cash flows stemming from alterations in a parent's ownership interest in a subsidiary that do not trigger a loss of control are categorized as financing activities. These transactions are treated as equity transactions, meaning their cash flows follow the standard classification for transactions with owners.
inclusion: Subsequent purchase or sale of a subsidiary's equity instruments by a parent without losing control
exclusion: Transactions causing a complete loss or initial acquisition of control
Subsidiaries held by an investment entity measured at fair value through profit or loss
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts with transactions that result in a loss or gain of control, which are classified under investing activities.

descriptors.definition: Investing and financing transactions that do not involve the use of cash or cash equivalents are excluded from the statement of cash flows. Such non-cash events are instead disclosed separately in the financial statements to provide complete information regarding capital and asset structure changes.
inclusion: Acquisition of assets by assuming direct liabilities or via leases
Acquisition of an entity through an equity issue
Conversion of debt into equity
exclusion: Transactions requiring direct cash or cash equivalent settlements
nearby_distinctions: Differentiated from standard cash flows because they alter asset and capital structures without triggering actual cash inflows or outflows.

descriptors.concept_name: Changes in liabilities arising from financing activities
descriptors.definition: Entities must provide disclosures that allow financial statement users to evaluate modifications in liabilities arising from financing activities, covering both cash and non-cash changes. This requirement can be fulfilled by presenting a reconciliation between opening and closing balance sheet liabilities classified under financing activities.
inclusion: Changes from financing cash flows
Changes from obtaining or losing control of businesses
Foreign exchange rate fluctuations and fair value changes
exclusion: Liabilities whose cash flows are classified under operating or investing activities
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes financing liabilities from operating and investing obligations by focusing specifically on items generating financing cash flows.

descriptors.concept_name: Components Of Cash And Cash Equivalents
descriptors.definition: An entity must disclose the specific components of cash and cash equivalents and reconcile those amounts with equivalent items reported in the balance sheet. Bank overdrafts repayable on demand that form an integral part of cash management are included as a component of cash and cash equivalents.
inclusion: Cash on hand and demand deposits
Bank overdrafts repayable on demand forming an integral part of cash management
exclusion: Bank overdrafts included in cash equivalents for cash flow statements that fail balance sheet netting-off criteria
Unrealized foreign exchange gains or losses on foreign currency balances
nearby_distinctions: Separates cash flow presentation treatment of bank overdrafts from balance sheet presentation rules which require strict netting-off compliance.

descriptors.definition: Entities must disclose significant cash and cash equivalent balances held that are restricted or unavailable for group use, accompanied by management commentary. Additional optional or required disclosures include undrawn borrowing facilities, operating capacity maintenance cash flows, and segment-wise cash flows.
inclusion: Cash balances restricted by legal or exchange controls
Amounts of undrawn borrowing facilities with restrictions
Operating, investing, and financing cash flows for each reportable segment
exclusion: Unrestricted cash balances freely available for general group operations
Standard statement of cash flow primary line items
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes freely available liquidity pools from encumbered or restricted funds held in specific regulated jurisdictions.

descriptors.concept_name: Extracts Of Financial Statements Of Listed Entity
descriptors.definition: Practical disclosures and statement extracts illustrate the real-world application of cash flow presentation formats for listed corporate entities. These extracts demonstrate how operating, investing, and financing activities are structured in published financial statements.
inclusion: Published cash flow statement extracts from annual reports
exclusion: Theoretical framework guidelines without empirical reporting context
nearby_distinctions: Provides applied disclosure documentation rather than standard-setting normative rules.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences In Ind AS 7 Vis-À-Vis AS 3
descriptors.definition: Ind AS 7 introduces explicit guidelines compared to AS 3, such as mandating bank overdrafts repayable on demand to be part of cash equivalents and requiring profit adjustments for undistributed earnings of associates. It also outlines precise treatments for rental assets held for sale, financing activity examples, and subsidiary control changes.
inclusion: Bank overdraft inclusion rules
Undistributed profit adjustments for associates and non-controlling interests
Specific rules for control acquisition and loss disclosures
exclusion: Separate classification of extraordinary activity cash flows present in older standards
Omissions found in legacy accounting standards
nearby_distinctions: Compares modern Indian Accounting Standards with legacy accounting standards to highlight enhanced convergence disclosures.
